# Agents (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

The AI agents: one file per agent, the agent loop and its read-only tools, the Use Case Planner, agent settings and the kill switch.

## Files

- `agent-loop.ts`: The agent loop (v1.6).
- `agent-routes.ts`: The engagement's agents: list, configure, add, duplicate and delete custom agents.
- `control-designer.ts`: Control Designer: proposes controls for a use case's approved risks, drawn from the control library.
- `control-tester.ts`: The Control Tester (Test controls stage): drafts a result for each open test of a use case from the evidence attached to it.
- `drafting.ts`: What the four drafting agents share (v1.7.7: each agent has its own file: evidence-collector.ts, control-tester.ts, review-assistant.ts, report-writer.ts).
- `evidence-collector.ts`: The Evidence Collector (Collect evidence stage): lists the evidence each control of a use case needs, what has arrived and what is still missing.
- `kill-switch-routes.ts`: The kill switch: stop an agent at once, audited.
- `plan-routes.ts`: Plans: where a use case starts.
- `planner.ts`: The Use Case Planner: the first agent a use case meets.
- `pricing.ts`: Model prices and run cost.
- `report-writer.ts`: The Report Writer (Board report stage): drafts the board summary for one use case from the figures ARGUS holds.
- `review-assistant.ts`: The Review assistant (Validate stage, role independent_reviewer): challenges a use case before sign-off.
- `risk-classifier.ts`: Risk Classifier: reads a use case profile and returns a tier, an oversight model and starting risks.
- `tools.ts`: Read-only tools the agents use to look things up (v1.6).
- `types.ts`: Shared shapes for agents: what the engine hands an agent for one run (the context) and what the agent hands back (its output and token usage).
- `prompts/`: the agents' rules files (rule 8).
